title: Build, don't just analyze: reconcile the two divergent Mind surfaces into one and stage it as a draft PR
statement: CORRECTION — the audit was right, the stop was wrong. The repository distinguishes building from installation, activation and consequence authority. Writing code on a dedicated branch and opening a draft PR is not merging, activating, spending, or exercising external authority; founder-only merge authority was never a reason not to build. After the reconnaissance phase, continue automatically into the highest-value unblocked build work: (1) reconcile the #139/#143 Cortex line with #145 and the #148 execution fabric into one Mind surface; (2) close buildable gaps such as spend accounting and worker-output-to-input composition; (3) leave VEPMC and real-world founder gates to the founder.
source_refs: founder message in this collaboration session, 2026-10-03 (correcting the under-execution of the full-machine completion audit)
binding_scope: uniimente-kernel repository; the Mind surface (cortex, greg/cognition, contracts, tests, cortex lineage records)
constitutional_constraints: merge authority remains founder-only; this work stages a draft PR on a dedicated branch, never a merge
no new authority plane, no second Kernel/GREG/mission system/routing plane/learning plane
every receipt keeps authority_created=false; capability growth is not authority growth
negative evidence, dissent and lineage are preserved; nothing is silently deleted
honest status labels: never claim TESTED or INTEGRATED beyond the evidence tier actually reached
model output is never represented as external evidence
secrets never enter signed commands or the ledger
success_evidence: one branch where cortex 0.4.0, the seed line (cortex/seed, seed_genome), the deterministic selector and the execution fabric coexist and import
historical imports (from greg.cognition import evaluate_problem, solve, settle) keep working
kept-test regression count versus the #148 head under an identical environment: zero
grafted tests that can execute in the build environment pass; offline-dependency-blocked tests are recorded as blocked, not as failures
mutation checks and the v4 verifier run are executed and recorded append-only, including FAIL runs
failure_evidence: any kept test that passed at the #148 head fails on the reconciliation branch for a non-environmental reason
any file unique to either line disappearing from the tree without an explicit, recorded supersession
any claim that the reconciliation is merged, activated, or founder-approved
any parallel canonical contract, gate, registry or governance system introduced by the reconciliation
dependencies: GitHub access to push the branch and open the draft PR
z3-solver, ortools, rfc3161_client for full offline verification (absent in the build sandbox; recorded as environmental)
conflicts: cognition.solve has two implementations (deterministic selector vs 0.4.0 competency compiler); resolved by keeping the compiler on the mission path and the selector directly callable, recorded in deliberation-one-mind-surface-20261003.json
next_review_trigger: founder review of the draft PR; any request to merge, activate, or extend scope beyond the staged surface
